title: VOOPOO DRAG X3 80W Pod Kit
description:
The
VOOPOO DRAG X3 80W Pod Kit
is a high-performance pod mod supporting external 18650 or 21700 batteries for maximum endurance. Features a 1.66” HD touchscreen, capacitive unlock sensor, and the PnP X platform for versatile MTL to DTL vaping.
Product Type:
Box Mod Pod Kit
Battery:
Single 18650 or 21700 (Sold Separately)
Wattage Range:
5-80W
Charging:
USB Type-C (5V/2A)
E-Liquid Capacity:
5mL
Coil Type:
Replaceable - uses PnP X coils
Coil Resistance:
0.15Ω and 0.3Ω (included)
Airflow:
Adjustable (Top Airflow)
Display:
1.66” HD Touchscreen
Fill Method:
Side Fill
Power Modes:
Smart / RBA / ECO
Material:
Zinc Alloy + Leather
Coil Compatibility:
All PnP X coils (0.15Ω to 1.0Ω) and PnP-TW coils
Pod Compatibility:
PnP X Cartridge MTL and PnP X Cartridge DTL
Brand:
VOOPOO
⚠ Not compatible with original PnP coils/pods (DRAG S, DRAG X, DRAG H80S) or Argus Pod cartridges. Uses PnP X platform only.
Battery and e-liquid sold separately. Compatible with both salt nic and freebase e-liquids depending on coil choice.
